items.en: Facets are removed from the game.

items.en: Refresher Orb resets abilities only, not items.

items.en: Shiva's Guard increases ability radius and no longer reduces healing.

items.en: Blade Mail builds from Splintmail, Arcane Boots from Wizard Hat.

items.en: 7.41e: a root during Twin Gates cancels the warp.
